Experimental offline English OCR assets, build checkpoint only.
Tesseract.js 7.0.0 (Apache-2.0); tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 (Apache-2.0).
bmp-js 0.1.0 (MIT); is-url 1.2.4 (MIT); regenerator-runtime 0.13.11 (MIT); wasm-feature-detect 1.9.0 (Apache-2.0). Each vendored package contains its license text. Three non-LSTM WebAssembly core variants are retained for portable CPU feature selection. English traineddata was copied from this development environment's tessdata_fast installation; Debian copyright and Apache-2.0 notice are in data/ENG-DATA-COPYRIGHT.txt. Chinese traineddata is not included. No network, installation, model download or external OCR executable is required by the WebAssembly adapter; this does not imply Mac validation or PDF rasterization support.
